title: US 10-Year Yield Tops 5%, AI Slowdown Concerns Hit Chipmakers
description:
"Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Tokyo and Sydney with Shery Ahn and Haidi Stroud-Watts, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - Bloomberg: The Asia Trade begins
00:02:09 - US 10-year yield tops 5% for first time since 2023
00:03:43 - US stocks fall as AI slowdown worries hit chipmakers
00:07:27 - Trump clashes with AI bosses over concerns
00:12:51 - Bank of America's Brian Moynihan on AI safety
00:16:31 - Pepperstone Group's Dilin Wu on markets outlook
00:28:31 - Nvidia CEO puts Trump on phone discussing AI risks
00:29:58 - BREAKING: Supreme Court rejects Trump's mail ballot curbs for midterms
00:34:21 - China's AI rally boosted by drug discovery
00:36:02 - Barclays CEO C.S. Venkatakrishnan on impact of AI
00:39:24 - EXCLUSIVE: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on US relations
00:43:15 - Kioxia said to consider raising $10B in US listing
00:47:34 - Markets open in Japan, South Korea and Australia
00:51:25 - Manulife Investment Management's Marc Franklin on markets strategy
01:04:09 - Markets mull calls for AI slowdown, guardrails
01:08:14 - Bloomberg Opinion: Timing of OpenAI IPO delay could hardly be worse for SoftBank
01:14:00 - China August credit growth misses forecasts
01:17:22 - Hong Kong to unveil its first five-year plan
01:22:54 - AUSTRALIA AHEAD: University of New South Wales' Toby Walsh on AI concerns
01:30:50 - Kioxia said to weigh US ADR sale as early as next year
